summary: Verified Jan 2026 client-side perf batch: ShopByBrand placement above NicheHero on both niche homes (desktop+mobile), PDP peek() warm-hydration, CartPage validateCart debounce, search regression, and admin login. All critical specs PASS. Backend was untouched — no new backend tests needed (covered by /app/backend/tests/test_perf_reliability_jan2026.py in iteration_10 which was 18/18 green).

issues: Mixed-content warnings: brand logos requested over http:// (lotus.in, dotandkey.com, thefaceshop.in, lakmeindia.com, swissbeauty.in). Chrome auto-upgrades to https so images load, but several of these third-party CDNs do not serve https for these paths — risk of broken brand tile images on stricter browsers. Sanitize brand.logo_url to force https or proxy via own CDN.
React warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — JSX attribute needs camelCase fetchPriority. Likely in . Cosmetic only.
React warning: UNSAFE_componentWillMount in strict mode (SideEffect(NullComponent)) — comes from react-helmet dependency. Not actionable in app code.

action_items: (Low) Sanitize brand logo URLs to https or proxy through own CDN — eliminates Mixed Content warnings on niche home pages.
(Low) Rename fetchpriority -> fetchPriority in JSX tag(s) to silence React DOM warning.
critical_code_review_comments: SkincareHome.js and CosmeticsHome.js correctly place <ShopByBrand niche=...> above <NicheHero ...> (lines 145-161 and 171-187 respectively). Verified positionally: skincare desktop brand.y=851 < hero.y=1183; skincare mobile 552<796; cosmetics desktop 817<1149; cosmetics mobile 572<816 — all four checks PASS.
CartPage debounce works as designed: 6 rapid + clicks on the qty button fired only ONE additional /api/cart/validate call (2 -> 3, delta=1). 250ms debounce is effective — backend load saved.

PDP peek() warm hydration: cold visit /product/anti-aging-serum = 1428ms, warm revisit = 620ms (2.3x speedup), no full-page spinner element observed on warm path — peek() seeding is doing its job. Note: the h1 wasn't yet in DOM at DOMContentLoaded (~250ms) — peek seeds *state* but React still needs one paint cycle. If main agent wants truly-instant h1, they could SSR the first paint, but this is well beyond spec.

Brand tiles count = 18 on each niche — comfortably above the 3-tile threshold required for ShopByBrand to render. Tile click verified: /brands/plum?niche=skincare loads BrandDetailPage with h1='Plum'.
Search regression PASS: typing 'serum' in skincare SearchBar surfaces a dropdown with '12 MATCHES' and product rows (Vitamin C Glow Serum, Pore Refiner Serum, etc.) — suggest endpoint healthy.

Admin login PASS: password celestaglow2024 -> /admin/dashboard -> /admin/products lists 7858 products with thumbnails, prices, stock. The image-first sort is the green 'Images first' chip in the filter row (already active by default in screenshot).
